canonical.behaviour: Adds the agreed blast-radius method and Unslop check to the workflow (agreement 1, R1-R12), in five tickets built in order. T1: a new reference file, skills/code-review/BLAST-RADIUS.md, owns the method. It finds the safety facts a change rests on, proves them on the 1-5 evidence ladder, looks where grep stops, lists Risks apart from Cleared items, and ends with the cheapest test to run before merging. code-review step 4b gets a wider trigger and a link to the file. T2: clarify, specify, plan-review, the lightweight-edit rule, the Inspect route, the Compatibility modifier, execute's ticket and whole-feature reviews, AUDIT's docs reviews and deliver all point to the method. T3: bug, feature, ui, refactor, migration, performance, architecture and docs-tests each name it at their own step; new-project does not. T4: WRITING.md gets a required Unslop check, run before the cold-reader check; SIMPLE-ENGLISH.md gets the numbered Unslop tells (Unslop 24 is not adopted); word-swaps and writing-for-agents point to them. It never changes app UI text, error messages or translations by itself. T5: credits with two MIT licence files, the README lines about pstack and writing, glossary terms, rule contracts, test docs, and a summary ready for CHANGELOG in the task records. Each ticket writes its tests first. No new registered skill, no hook or script change, no release records.
exclusions: No change to hooks/ or to any script under skills/ or tools/
No commit, push, branch, install or tools/verification_summary.py --write
No edit to installed copies under ~/.agents/skills or to the global ~/.claude/skills/unslop
No new registered skill and no change to plugin.json or marketplace.json
No release records: version.json, CHANGELOG.md, UPGRADE.md and VALIDATION.md stay unchanged for the separate rc.3 step
README skill counts and the /spar lines, and the workflow-clarify step 3 /spar bullet, belong to the other session and stay unchanged
SIMPLE-ENGLISH rules 1-12, WRITING 'Keep the meaning' and the offer presentation rules stay unchanged
The correct loop and the verification skills are follow-ups, not built here
conditions: Before the first edit, rerun the baseline when the commit, tracked diff or tool versions differ from PLAN's baseline
No file under skills/ except the .LICENSE files names pstack, Lauren Tan or upstream
Tickets run in order T1 to T5; each test is written first and seen failing where a red phase exists
checks: Cold-reader checks by a fresh subagent for BLAST-RADIUS.md (T1) and the Unslop check (T4)
Each ticket's targeted tests from TODO.md pass
Ticket reviews and a whole-feature review, Standards and Spec, by a fresh subagent
W3 blast radius on this change: every reader of the changed files traced by reading its code and proven by its test
W5 source-name search exits 0 with no output
docs_check --changed on the edited files reports 0 blocking
python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" passes, with failures that existed before named apart
